title: Random Rogue
description: Have you ever wanted Minecraft to be completely luck-based and completely RNG? Well then this is the mod for you!
body:
This mod makes minecraft completely luck-based and ~~ridiculously chaotic~~ ridiculous. It is a few random features which can either give extreme bonuses, or make the game very difficult. Fun to mess around with for an hour, or try to beat the game.

**Not for a serious gameplay**!

![Gambling menu.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b72713b0394723c2b7a65c7d6560450afed6662.png)

# This mod currently adds:
- A GUI in which you can lose or gain attributes, health and items from your inventory
- A Slot machine for many items (mainly biome-exclusive ones) which costs 5 xp levels
- Random funny events that can happen at any moment upon certain triggers
  (examples: jumping, breaking blocks, sleeping, sending chat messages)
- Scratch cards, although they are WIP and can occasionally be buggy and have few rewards so far.

_Credits to MrBenjaroo for helping with the code_
